claim: Static-BAR1 P2P works on all 12 ordered pairs of four CMP 170HX (5.79 GB/s each, every byte verified) once every card has a 64 GiB BAR1 and the PCIe layout is hand-programmed before driver load.
stance_target: the repo's premise that P2P is unavailable on this card in every configuration
scope_conditions: 4x CMP 170HX, 65,536 MiB each, Gen2 x16, GPU0+GPU1 behind PLX switch A and GPU2+GPU3 behind switch B on CPU2, dual Xeon E5-2686 v4, bare metal and one LXC run, 180 W
quoted_support: Direct GPU-to-GPU access works on all 12 ordered pairs of four cards (every byte verified, 5.79 GB/s each, 16 us at 4 KiB). It needs the memory unlock's 64 GiB BAR1 on **every** card, and on this board two cards behind one PLX switch only get that with a hand-programmed PCIe layout applied before the driver loads.

claim: P2P lifts Qwen3.8-27B TP2 single-user decode by 11-14% but slows GLM-5.3-Flash TP4 decode by 25-44%, because the host-staged all-reduce vLLM selects without P2P is faster on this PLX + Broadwell path.
stance_target: cc-6's committed reading that P2P is a latency lever, not a bandwidth lever, and that it does not help the many-small-collectives regime
scope_conditions: same 4x CMP 170HX rig at Gen2 x16, 180 W, Qwen3.8-27B W4A16 TP2 and GLM-5.3-Flash TP4 (Morrowmake 1.6.0 protocol)
quoted_support: P2P cuts small-copy latency by up to 1.77x and lifts Qwen3.8-27B TP2 single-user decode by 11-14 %, but it **slows** GLM-5.3-Flash TP4 decode by 25-44 %: the host-staged all-reduce vLLM picks without P2P is faster on this PLX + Broadwell path.

claim: The BIOS placed switch A's 64-bit window at the top of CPU2's 1 TiB aperture at 224 MiB, so a second card on that switch got no BAR1 and static BAR1 refused to start it with -EIO; the fix is to program every BAR and bridge window by hand with each BAR3 directly below its 64 GiB-aligned BAR1 and then kexec.
stance_target: the practical cost of enabling BAR1 P2P on a 5-card box (a board-specific, hard-coded layout step)
scope_conditions: dual Xeon E5-2686 v4 Broadwell host, BIOS Above 4G on, MMIO high 1024G, kernel 7.0.2, pci=realloc
quoted_support: The BIOS places each switch's 64-bit window at the top of CPU2's 1 TiB aperture (224 MiB for switch A), so it cannot grow; the second card on a switch gets no BAR1 and static BAR1 refuses to start it (`-EIO`).
